items.claim: Magny's chin is compromised and he is very hittable.
items.quote: Magny's chin is is very much compromised these days. He's very hitable.

items.claim: Magny lacks power and has very suspect defense.
items.quote: His defense is very very suspect and he doesn't have a ton of power.

items.claim: Ramiz Brahimi has a very good submission game and solid takedowns.
items.quote: Ramiz does have a very good submission game. His takedowns are solid.

items.claim: Rafael Tobias has really solid grappling and nasty submission skills.
items.quote: really, really solid grappling, nasty submission skills

items.claim: Rafael Tobias's striking power is present but very sloppy.
items.quote: on the feet, I mean, he's got some power, but it's very, very sloppy.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando throws good technical sharp straight punches with a strong jab and straight right.
items.quote: he throws good technical sharp straight punches, man. That jab is right down the middle.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando works the body incredibly well.
items.quote: he works the body incredibly well.
